interaction_steps.prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).

tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat go.mod | head -n 12 && rg -n "type ClientConn interface|type State struct|UpdateState|ResolveNow|resolverWrapper|newCCResolverWrapper|ErrNoSubConnAvailable|ErrTransientFailure|pickErr" resolver clientconn.go rpc_util.go balancer*.go'

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '90,195p' resolver/resolver.go && rg -n \"type ccResolverWrapper|UpdateState\\(|reportError|newCCResolverWrapper\" resolver_wrapper.go clientconn.go && sed -n '1,260p' resolver_wrapper.go && rg -n \"ErrTransientFailure|ErrNoSubConnAvailable|PickResult|Pick\\(\" clientconn.go call.go balancer"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"ccResolverWrapper|UpdateState\\(s resolver.State|func \\(.*\\) UpdateState|pickerWrapper|pickErr\" --glob '*.go' | head -100 && sed -n '820,930p' clientconn.go && rg -n \"ErrTransientFailure|ErrNoSubConnAvailable\""
/bin/zsh -lc "cat resolver_conn_wrapper.go && cat picker_wrapper.go && sed -n '90,170p' clientconn.go && sed -n '210,275p' balancer/balancer.go"
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '520,660p' clientconn.go && sed -n '220,270p' balancer_conn_wrappers.go && sed -n '1080,1140p' clientconn.go && sed -n '290,345p' clientconn.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "gofmt -w resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go && rg -n \"resolver\\.ClientConn|ClientConn interface|NewAddress\\(.*\\[\\]resolver.Address\" --glob '*.go' | head -80 && git diff -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go"

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer/base/balancer.go pickfirst.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- resolver/resolver.go resolver_conn_wrapper.go balancer_conn_wrappers.go pickfirst.go balancer/base/balancer.go resolver/dns/dns_resolver_test.go xds/internal/resolver/xds_resolver_test.go'
